messages:
alex_support: CedarFall (acct cedarfall-prod) reported a p99 latency jump on embeddings + chat since ~04:00 UTC. Baseline p99 was ~300ms, now 1.8–2.4s. They say checkout flows are timing out. Sample repro: prod -> POST /v1/embeddings bulk (batch_size=8, seq<=512). Sample req ids: req_1a2b3c

maria_sre: Oncall — digging into shard metrics now. Can you dump a couple more req_ids + exact timestamps? Any Redwood deploys around that window?

alex_support: More ids: req_1a2b3c (04:07:12 UTC), req_4d5e6f (04:08:01 UTC). No deploys from our side afaict.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: No deploys to serving in window 03:30–04:30 UTC.

zaheer_oncall: I see a noisy tenant on shard-gpu-12 — tenant 'horizon-ai' spiked concurrent embeddings with many long contexts. Their concurrency pushed the host into queueing territory and caused KV cache thrash.

maria_sre: Confirming — `redis.queue.depth.shard-gpu-12` spiked to ~120, now trending. `kvcache_hit_ratio` dropped from 0.94 -> 0.38 around 04:05. That matches the timings.

lisa_custsuccess: CedarFall asked if we can prioritize their checkout requests (they're willing to pay). They want an allowlist so critical paths don't hit p99.

alex_support: Quick question — do we have a short-term tenant-level allowlist / reservation we can apply while we investigate?

maria_sre: Two mitigations available: 1) create a short-lived soft reservation for cedarfall on shard-gpu-12 (30m) to cap noisy neighbor interference; 2) add cedarfall to priority-lane allowlist to bypass some batching/queue heuristics. I'll fire #1 now: `reservation create --tenant cedarfall-prod --shard shard-gpu-12 --cap 40 --ttl 30m`.

zaheer_oncall: Reservation applied. Queue depth fell from 120 -> 18 within ~3 minutes. Observed cedarfall p99 drop to ~720ms immediately. Still monitoring for residual KV cache warmup.

alex_support: Customer reports immediate improvement in checkout latency. They want a follow-up: permanent weekday window allowlist (03:00–06:00 UTC) or a proposal for a committed reservation.

maria_sre: Follow-ups: (a) propose recurring reservation for peak window, (b) recommend they reduce batch_size or shard across multiple API keys, (c) discuss Redwood Dedicated if they need guaranteed isolation. I'll open an internal ticket and draft runbook steps (how to create/rollback reservations, metrics to watch: p99, queue depth, kvcache_hit_ratio).

alex_support: Thanks — opening escalation to account + billing to propose short-term committed reservation. Tagging @lisa_custsuccess to lead pricing.

lisa_custsuccess: On it. Will prepare a 30-day committed capacity quote and include options for scheduled reservations during their peak UTC window.

incidents-bot: incidents-bot: Incident created INC-2026-307 (customer-impacting). Assigned: maria_sre, zaheer_oncall.

alex_support: Closing thread for now — reservation holding and p99 under 800ms. Reopen if p99 > 900ms in next 24h or if noisy tenant resurges.
